name: Rookery Bay NERR, SW Florida

mndwi.label: MNDWI
mndwi.desc: Modified NDWI, less sensitive to atmospheric noise (Xu 2006)

analysis.label: trend
analysis.desc: Least-squares slope of the index through the record, in index units per year. Negative is browning/loss, positive is greening/recovery.

analysis.label: trend significance
analysis.desc: Trend divided by its own standard error. A large number means the slope is well constrained by the record, not merely large.

analysis.label: seasonal amplitude
analysis.desc: Half the fitted wet-to-dry swing. A cell with a big number has a strong seasonal cycle; a flat one has none.

analysis.label: seasonal peak
analysis.desc: Season the fitted swing peaks in, drawn as a month: August for a wet-season peak, January for a dry-season one. The composites are six months apart, so a precise date is not resolvable.

analysis.label: seasonal fit R²
analysis.desc: Share of the record explained by trend plus season. Low values are erratic cells: disturbance, regime change, or too few good composites.

analysis.label: largest anomaly
analysis.desc: Largest residual from the fitted trend and season, in units of the cell's own residual scatter. Hover a cell for the composite.

events.label: COVID-19
events.full: COVID-19 shutdown; reduced boat traffic and dredging

note: Surface reflectance, spectral indices and a per-cell assessment of the whole record. No land-cover classification is applied anywhere in this pipeline.
